f3_program: collection("graveyard.skeletons", "skeleton", "graveyard", source("In a graveyard, there are 20 skeletons"))
observe(at("graveyard.skeletons.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("there are 20 skeletons"))
fraction_of(at("graveyard.skeletons.adult_women.count", "current"), at("graveyard.skeletons.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Half of these skeletons are adult women"))

difference_relation(at("graveyard.skeletons.remaining.count", "current"), at("graveyard.skeletons.count", "current"), at("graveyard.skeletons.adult_women.count", "current"), source("Half of these skeletons are adult women, and the remaining number are split evenly between adult men and children"))

fraction_of(at("graveyard.skeletons.adult_men.count", "current"), at("graveyard.skeletons.remaining.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("the remaining number are split evenly between adult men and children"))

fraction_of(at("graveyard.skeletons.children.count", "current"), at("graveyard.skeletons.remaining.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("the remaining number are split evenly between adult men and children"))
observe(at("adult_woman.body.bones.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("an adult woman has 20 bones in their body"))
offset(at("adult_man.body.bones.count", "current"), at("adult_woman.body.bones.count", "current"), 5, "count", source("a male has 5 more than this"))
fraction_of(at("child.body.bones.count", "current"), at("adult_woman.body.bones.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("a child has half as many as an adult woman"))
query("value", at("graveyard.bones.count", "current"))

assumptions: The requested weekly value requires the unstated calendar fact specifying the number of days in a week.

f3_program: observe(at("brendan.waiter_wage.rate", "this_week"), 6, "currency_per_hour", source("Brendan makes $6/hour as a waiter"))
observe(at("brendan.scheduled_shifts.eight_hour.count", "this_week"), 2, "count", source("2 8-hour shifts"))
observe(at("brendan.scheduled_shifts.eight_hour.duration_per_shift", "this_week"), 8, "hour", source("2 8-hour shifts"))
observe(at("brendan.scheduled_shifts.twelve_hour.count", "this_week"), 1, "count", source("1 12-hour shift"))
observe(at("brendan.scheduled_shifts.twelve_hour.duration_per_shift", "this_week"), 12, "hour", source("1 12-hour shift"))
observe(at("brendan.tips.average_rate", "this_week"), 12, "currency_per_hour", source("an average of $12 in tips each hour"))
rate_relation(at("brendan.wages.earned.amount", "this_week"), at("brendan.waiter_wage.rate", "this_week"), at("brendan.work.duration", "this_week"), source("Brendan makes $6/hour as a waiter"))
rate_relation(at("brendan.tips.earned.amount", "this_week"), at("brendan.tips.average_rate", "this_week"), at("brendan.work.duration", "this_week"), source("an average of $12 in tips each hour"))
fraction_of(at("brendan.tips.reported_to_irs.amount", "this_week"), at("brendan.tips.earned.amount", "this_week"), 1, 3, source("he only reports 1/3rd of his tips to the IRS"))

percent_of(at("brendan.taxes.paid.amount", "this_week"), at("brendan.irs_reported_income.amount", "this_week"), 20, source("Brendan is supposed to pay 20% of his income in taxes, but he only reports 1/3rd of his tips to the IRS"))
query("value", at("brendan.taxes.paid.amount", "this_week"))
assumptions: The contrast with IRS reporting is interpreted to mean that the 20% payment is applied to reported income and that waiter wages are reported in full.

f3_program: collection("debate.students", "student", "stage", source("students from three different schools taking part in a debate organized by the town's mayor on a stage"))

multiple(at("debate.first_school.students.count", "during_debate"), at("debate.second_school.students.count", "during_debate"), 2, source("The first school had twice as many students as the second school"))

offset(at("debate.second_school.students.count", "during_debate"), at("debate.third_school.students.count", "during_debate"), 40, "count", source("the second school had 40 more students than the third school"))
observe(at("debate.third_school.students.count", "during_debate"), 200, "count", source("the third school had 200 students"))
same(at("debate.students.who_shook_mayor_hand.count", "after_debate"), at("debate.students.count", "during_debate"), source("every student shook the mayor's hand"))
query("value", at("debate.students.who_shook_mayor_hand.count", "after_debate"))
collection("house.bedrooms", "bedroom", "house", source("There are 3 bedrooms"))
observe(at("house.bedrooms.count", "renovation"), 3, "count", source("There are 3 bedrooms"))
observe(at("house.bedrooms.renovation_duration_per_bedroom", "renovation"), 4, "hour", source("each bedroom takes 4 hours to renovate"))
percent_more(at("house.kitchen.renovation_duration", "renovation"), at("house.bedrooms.renovation_duration_per_bedroom", "renovation"), 50, source("The kitchen takes 50% longer than each bedroom"))

multiple(at("house.living_room.renovation_duration", "renovation"), at("house.everything_except_living_room.renovation_duration", "renovation"), 2, source("The living room took twice as much time as everything else combined"))
query("value", at("house.renovation_duration.total", "renovation"))
assumptions: “Everything else” is interpreted as the three bedrooms and the kitchen, the other renovation areas named in the source.
